article.detail:
OpenAI於10月30日宣布，將尊重網站在robots.txt表達的共通基礎生成式AI訓練偏好訊號，目標是在未來數月實作。

參與供應商可接收同一偏好，減少網站逐個爬蟲維護規則的工作。

公司表示現有robots.txt爬蟲控制不會被取代；新訊號建基於IETF AI Preferences工作組的持續工作。

品牌網站與內容出版團隊可把訓練偏好納入內容治理，並與搜尋可見度及其他用途的政策分開檢視。

記錄現行爬蟲規則、網站內容權責與偏好，待官方公布實作細節後再交技術團隊評估變更。

這是自願性參與及未來實作承諾，並非已部署完成、所有AI供應商均遵守，亦不構成內容權利或法律效力判定。
article.detail_en:
OpenAI announced October 30 that it will honor a shared robots.txt signal for foundational generative-AI training preferences, aiming to implement it in the coming months.

Participating providers can receive a common preference, reducing separate crawler-rule maintenance.

Existing robots.txt crawler controls remain in place; the initiative draws on ongoing IETF AI Preferences work.

Brand sites and publishers can include training preferences in content governance while separately reviewing search visibility and other uses.

Document crawler rules, content ownership and preferences, then assess changes when implementation details are published.

This is a voluntary initiative and implementation commitment, not completed deployment, universal provider compliance or a legal determination of content rights.
